paper: Logical Guidance for the Exact Composition of Diffusion Models
statement: On GRM5-RRM1, LOGDIFF has AND docking-product 73.20 +/- 3.18 versus DualDiff 71.87 +/- 3.33, and AND-NOT target separation 0.94 +/- 0.24 versus DualDiff 0.28 +/- 0.08.

AND-NOT.metric: average difference between minimum and maximum target docking scores

direct_verification_requirements: Eight independent 32-ligand experiments for each method and condition
The named LOGDIFF and DualDiff algorithms, not a nearby proxy
Exactly 23 atoms, 1000 denoising steps, beta 2.0, and the aligned GRM5-RRM1 pockets
AutoDock Vina scores for both targets for every valid ligand
An explicit definition of the reported spread and the AND-NOT delta statistic
Independent payload, docking, aggregation, and method-label checks
A negative control that detects corrupted target labels, method labels, or docking rows
verified_if: A faithful full campaign reproduces the reported method comparison with protocol parity and uncertainty visible.
falsified_if: A faithful full campaign satisfying every paper assumption yields an assumption-satisfying contradiction to the stated values or comparison.
blocked_if: Any method, condition, experiment, raw ligand set, docking table, exact source/input binding, or metric definition needed for the direct comparison is absent.
partial_evidence_rule: Incomplete ligands, partial experiments, LOGDIFF-only campaigns, or undocked payloads cannot establish VERIFIED or FALSIFIED.
